title: [Enhancement] SMS Commands from a non-smart phone
symptom: User works in an environment where smart phones are not allowed for security reasons, but phones without a camera (old models) are allowed. They cannot use these phones because they cannot take a photo of the QR code for 2FA, and they ask if there is a way to use such phones without 2FA setup or with a portable token generator.
evidence_quote: I cannot use them though as I cannot take a photo of the QR-Code for 2FA. Is there a way not to use 2FA setup and use this type of phone?
